items.statement: Each canonical trade is accounted for as matched or broken, and each later duplicate trade identifier is broken rather than silently dropped.
A counterpart is eligible only after normalized account, instrument, settlement date, and currency agree; tolerance checks cannot bypass identity compatibility.
An override cannot create a match when no concrete position or settlement candidate exists.
items.enforcementPoint: Override eligibility validation before matched output is written.

items.statement: An identical rerun cannot create duplicate business output or duplicate ledger history.
items.enforcementPoint: Run fingerprinting, deterministic report generation, and rerun tests.
